title: Female E-commerce and Editorial Pose Library

source.transcriptionPolicy: Wording, capitalization, hyphenation and punctuation are preserved from the source. Only visual line wrapping and bold styling are normalized.

reference.name: Female Reference
reference.prompt: Full body e-commerce catalogue photograph of a female fashion model, standing facing the camera. Young adult Caucasian woman in her mid twenties with fair skin, long blonde hair falling just past the shoulders in a soft straight style with a center part, blue-grey eyes, clean natural beauty makeup with light foundation, subtle brow and soft neutral lip. She wears a fitted plain white crew-neck t-shirt tucked into mid-blue straight-leg jeans and plain white leather sneakers. Standing in a relaxed neutral pose, arms resting naturally at her sides, weight even, looking directly into the lens with a calm confident expression. Evenly lit professional studio, seamless neutral white background, soft diffused lighting. Sharp focus, high resolution, natural realistic skin, entire body and shoes fully in frame, gentle shadow at the feet, product photography.
